apps.name: USB Microscope
apps.tagline: Live view, zoom, LED and recording for cheap USB microscopes
apps.description: A PyQt5 app for cheap USB microscope cameras on Linux. Shows a live UVC video stream, digital zoom and rotation, snapshot and H.264 video recording, crosshair/grid overlays, vibration compensation, point-to-point measurement with calibration, auto-detected hardware controls (LED/illumination, hardware zoom, exposure, and other v4l2 controls), and remembers your settings between runs.
apps.author: JapySoft
